Module io.github.brantunger.unruly.core
Package io.github.brantunger.unruly.api

Interface FactStore<T extends @Nullable Object>

Type Parameters:
T - The object/value type of the fact. A fact's value, and a FactReference in the store, can be null.
All Known Implementing Classes:
FactMap
public interface FactStore<T extends @Nullable Object>
A store of facts, each kept under its name. Rules refer to a fact by that name. FactMap is the built-in implementation.

The engine reads the facts through asMap() once, when a run starts, and each FactReference's value once too, and never changes the store. A fact added, replaced or removed while that run is going isn't seen by it; a change inside the object a fact's value was at the start is. So one store can serve one run after another.
